name: mpractice-australia
description: mPractice for Aussie Citizenship by mStudio – practice app for the Australian Citizenship Test (Our Common Bond)
author: Martin Yeung (mStudio) <mstudiosolutions@gmail.com>

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build.py --check && rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html privacy.html dist/
scripts.build:www: node scripts/build-www.mjs && tailwindcss -i scripts/tailwind.css -o www/app.css --content www/index.html --minify
scripts.ios: npm run build:www && cap sync ios
